about: The eight pick_obs views (design 3.4, 3.6; TR-11 creates them, TR-24 reads them). Column types are contract types;
TR-11 checks them against information_schema through VIEW_PG_TYPES. Runtime tables (cookie jar, request log, lease) never appear.
Each valid row is what the reader role sees; invalid rows break one column's contract.
Text columns naming an enum take its values; states, links and alerts rows are StateRow, LinkRow and AlertRow; a sets row's
frozen_inputs and summary are FrozenInputs and SetSummary and agree with its columns. unknown_view is a view that does not exist.
